title: fix(proxy): keep the final response of a response.incomplete event

files.patch:
@@ -22,6 +22,7 @@ All notable changes to DreamCoder will be documented in this file.
 ### Fixed
 
 - **Gemini and similar OpenAI-compatible providers** (#139): parallel tool calls streamed without an `index` run as separate calls instead of being merged into one. A turn that calls tools and ends with finish_reason `stop` now reports `tool_use`. Thanks @pcbeingused333.
+- **ChatGPT sign-in:** a reply that stops at the output limit (`response.incomplete`) is reported as `max_tokens` with its tool calls and token usage, instead of `end_turn` with plain text and zero usage.
 - **Agent teams:** opening a teammate from the team view shows its conversation instead of an empty page.
   - Each teammate now keeps one transcript. Before, every message it received started a new file with its whole history copied in.
   - Transcripts written before this update still open.

+describe('openaiResponsesStreamToAnthropicResponse', () => {
+  const output = [
+    { type: 'message', role: 'assistant', content: [{ type: 'output_text', text: 'partial' }] },
+    { type: 'function_call', call_id: 'call_1', name: 'Read', arguments: '{"path":"a"}' },
+  ]
+
+  test.each([
+    ['response.completed', 'completed', 'tool_use'],
+    ['response.incomplete', 'incomplete', 'max_tokens'],
+  ])('keeps the final response of a %s event', async (event, status, stopReason) => {
+    const response = {
+      id: 'resp_1',
+      model: 'gpt-5.6-terra',
+      status,
+      output,
+      usage: { input_tokens: 12, output_tokens: 7 },
+    }
+    const result = await openaiResponsesStreamToAnthropicResponse(
+      makeStream([`event: ${event}\ndata: ${JSON.stringify({ type: event, response })}\n\n`]),
+      'm',
+    )
+
+    expect(result.stop_reason).toBe(stopReason)
+    expect(result.usage).toEqual({ input_tokens: 12, output_tokens: 7 })
+    expect(result.content.map(block => block.type)).toEqual(['text', 'tool_use'])
+  })
+})
